risks: Empty explicit dependencies can make the scheduler incorrectly launch writes before hidden architecture gates are accepted; foundation receipts must be a separate start condition.
CRAFT_SERVER_URL currently only changes logging; treating that branch or native live gates as authenticated multi-user enforcement would misrepresent local tokens/identity as remote authority.
Org channels are currently LOCAL_ONLY. Removing that gate without canonical Actor/org policy exposes local bookkeeping rather than implementing authenticated shared mode.
Current RequestContext and handler dependencies do not expose a demonstrated canonical Actor. Client Actor/userId/granted/capability advertisement must never become org authority.
Existing sole-owner demotion guard is valuable but read-modify-write JSON has no shared CAS/transaction guarantee, no revoke operation and no revision conflict receipt.

Local acceptInvite deliberately supports userId override and soft recipient match, and tokens are stored plaintext without shared expiry. Preserve explicit local semantics; shared redemption requires different authenticated recipient/token protection on canonical authority.
listOrganizations returns all local members; renderer memberCount exposes their array size. Authorization must filter before aggregation, including denied count/title/body in search/push/memory.

Settings and Connections routes collapse to page roots, and persisted settings keys lose org/view context; a new component alone cannot satisfy deep links, Back/Forward or same Connections detail route.

refresh overwrites identity drafts; local React-only org selection/forms lose state across navigation. Policy-safe draft preservation and revoke cleanup need deliberate shared retention, not unconditional persistence of sensitive fields.
Connections audit failure currently becomes [], which can look like genuine empty. Hub audit/metric states must distinguish unavailable/forbidden/timeout from empty and actual sampled zero.

Native source gates synthesize receipt_verified states before domain command execution; they are not actual persisted command receipts or authorization. Shared success must follow real command receipt/readback.
Membership activity/search/Inbox/agent-memory retraction, cross-product identity and provider-live evidence cannot be established from local page/helper source. These gates remain required, not N/A.
All normative NEW admin paths are absent; no workspace-service foundation was broadly inspected. Do not silently create a parallel store/service to compensate for an unavailable accepted contract.

Shared files may change while root integrates wave0. Hash-pinned observations are working-tree evidence, not input-HEAD source proof; root must invalidate changed seams and keep completion tied to tested integrated commit.

Provider failure/export recovery and source-pinned Linux/macOS/native accessibility lanes remain unrun. No schema validator, report, screenshot inspiration or local storage test source can complete this feature.
